features.name: x001_norm
features.description: Range-normalized x001 on the observed 0 to 3 ordinal scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places x001 on a common 0-1 scale so the linear SVM can use a stable margin coefficient.

features.name: x002_norm
features.description: Range-normalized x002 on the observed 0 to 3 ordinal scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Places x002 on a common 0-1 scale so the linear SVM can use a stable margin coefficient.

features.name: x003_norm
features.description: Range-normalized x003 on the observed 0 to 3 ordinal scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Keeps the four-level x003 signal numerically comparable with the other ordinal inputs.

features.name: x004_norm
features.description: Range-normalized x004 on the observed 0 to 2 ordinal scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a calibrated single-column severity coordinate for x004.

features.name: x005_norm
features.description: Range-normalized x005 on the observed 0 to 2 ordinal scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a calibrated single-column severity coordinate for x005.

features.name: x006_norm
features.description: Range-normalized x006 on the observed 0 to 2 ordinal scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Gives the linear SVM a calibrated single-column severity coordinate for x006.

features.name: leading_pair_load_norm
features.description: Average magnitude of the first two four-level ordinal columns after range scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact projection of the leading-pair burden pattern, which can improve regularized margin stability.

features.name: core_support_interaction_norm
features.description: Multiplicative joint score for x004 and x006 after scaling both to 0-1.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth synergy coordinate that a purely linear use of the raw ordinal columns would not express directly.

features.name: core_minimum_level_count_norm
features.description: Normalized count of minimum-level observations among x004 and x006.
features.expected_model_benefit: Exposes gate-like low-end patterns as a simple severity measure for the linear SVM margin.

features.name: support_to_load_ratio
features.description: Smoothed ratio of the range-scaled later-column support sum to the range-scaled leading-pair load sum.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures trade-off structure in one numeric coordinate, helping linear margins represent relative rather than only additive effects.

features.name: semantic_balance_score
features.description: Ordinal semantic assessment of whether the six-coordinate profile is well-rounded; 0.0 means highly uneven with strong bottlenecks, and 1.0 means balanced across the available ordinal dimensions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies a holistic smooth signal for cases where several mild weaknesses combine, giving the linear SVM an additional margin input.

features.name: semantic_tradeoff_score
features.description: Ordinal semantic assessment of whether the last four coordinates provide enough support relative to the first two coordinates; 0.0 means poor trade-off, and 1.0 means strong trade-off. The score must be assigned from row values alone using the same rule for every row.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures broad support-versus-load evidence in one calibrated coordinate, helping the linear SVM use holistic trade-off patterns.
